what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted by voice to ask the town for money for Marshall Park engineering and schematic design, plus a larger sum for construction and site development.
The commission agreed to ask for engineering funds separately and to leave bathroom construction out of the town request, pursuing a USDA loan or grant instead.
The chair will fill out the Google application form for the funding request, due Friday.
Commissioners will attend the October 4th Select Board meeting, and the chair will post a meeting notice in case a quorum attends.
The October meeting will take up other funding sources for Marshall Park, the bathrooms and McNally.

why_it_matters: The request draws on the town's ARPA money, which is limited and shared among town projects, so what Parks asks for affects what is left for other projects.
Leaving bathrooms out of the town ask and aiming for a USDA loan means that part of Marshall Park depends on borrowing or grants that have not yet been applied for.
